metadata.title: Two Jumbo Jets, One Runway, and a Misunderstood Word
metadata.description:
Tenerife saw two jumbo jets collide on a foggy runway. The cause: ambiguous radio phrasing, blocked transmissions and zero visibility on a single runway.

Failure chain: Diverted flights crowd small airport → Thick fog rolls in → Ambiguous radio phrase → Transmissions block each other → Take-off with a jet on the runway

Related episode: How Colgan 3407 Really Failed — https://youtu.be/uuJwJwP-rzw

Series — Aviation Failures: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHIwDgtDRNyY
